inventory.sourceBook: First Aid for the USMLE Step 1 2026
inventory.visualPurpose: The 12-row oncogene table + the 15-row tumor suppressor table (book 220)
inventory.sourceFigureDescription: The oncogene definition (gain of function, one allele) and the 12-row oncogene table (ALK, EGFR, HER2, RET, BCR-ABL, JAK2, BRAF, c-KIT, MYCC, MYCN, KRAS, BCL-2) with their gene products and associated neoplasms; the tumor suppressor definition (loss of function, two alleles — Knudson 2-hit) and the 15-row tumor suppressor table (APC, BRCA1/2, CDKN2A, DCC, SMAD4, MEN1, NF1, NF2, PTEN, RB1, TP53, TSC1, TSC2, VHL, WT1) with their gene products and associated conditions. Pure text, no figures.
inventory.kypLocation: the registry visual (the two-table panel map with the allele axis) + blocks[1] and blocks[2] the table blocks carried verbatim

notes: The page's two text tables (the 12-row oncogene table and the 15-row tumor suppressor table) are the only visual element — pure text, no figures, no photographs (pdfimages confirmed zero rasters). Adapted as the registry visual (the two-table panel map) and carried verbatim in the note's table blocks. No copyrighted photographs; nothing reproduced. No margin mnemonics; the KYP memory layer is original.
